english.title: Fail to provide sufficient material to ensure the printing of tachograph records could be carried out on inspection
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to provide sufficient materials to ensure that the printing of records could be carried out correctly, in the event of an inspection, in contravention of Article 14 of the Community Recording Equipment Regulation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 97(1)(a) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Section 97(7) defines the "Community Recording Equipment Regulation" as Council Regulation (EEC ) No. 561/06, as amended.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Where the failure is because of a reason other the provision of sufficient printing material - CJS Code TR68279 and H9539.
